events.title: 1001 KIZ Festival – Marrakech
events.summary: The third edition of 1001 KIZ Festival runs at Grand Mogador Agdal & Spa with workshops, social dancing and evening parties. Confirmed DJs listed include DJ PUTO X, DJ NAO, DJ ANONY TARRAXA, DJ BAD and DJ YOUSS.

events.title: The Moroccan Incident
events.summary: The String Cheese Incident host a three-night destination gathering in Marrakech, with admission covering performances at Villa Marco on September 24, 25 and 26, 2026. Travel packages also reference an attendee pre-party and a Friday VIP bonus SCI set.
